Im September 2021 bricht auf La Palma die Erde auf. Lavaströme vernichten einen Teil der Insel. Tausende Menschen verlieren ihre Existenz. Augenzeugenberichte, private Aufnahmen und neueste Erkenntnisse klären auf, wie es dazu kommen konnte.

Während einer großen Grabungskampagne legen über 100 Experten unberührte Teile der antiken Stadt Pompeji frei. Dank modernster 3D-Messtechniken und sensationeller Skelettfunde, die erstmals DNA-Analysen der Bewohner ermöglichen, gewinnen die Forscher völlig neue Erkenntnisse. Begleiten Sie den Chefausgräber Massimo Osanna und sein Team und erhalten Sie Einblicke in das pulsierende Alltagsleben kurz vor der verheerenden Katastrophe!

Die größte philippinische Insel Luzon liegt auf dem Pazifischen Feuerring. Viele Bewohner der Insel sind immer wieder mit den Naturgewalten konfrontiert. Die Eruption des Pinatubo vor mehr als 30 Jahren vertrieb das indigene Volk der Aeta.

In den Anden bebt die Erde - und es entstehen Rohstoffe. Der Geologe Colin Devey begibt sich auf Expedition, um die Kräfte des Erdinneren zu erforschen. Seine Reise führt vom alten Inka-Erbe in Cusco bis ins raue chilenische Hochland.

Der Geologe Colin Devey erkundet, wie Wind, Eis und Wasser die Anden formen. Von Patagonien bis zur Atacama-Wüste zeigt die Dokumentation ein faszinierendes Naturlabor, in dem atmosphärische Kräfte die einzigartigen Landschaften bilden.
pr.sub: Expedition Anden - Die Kraft von Wind und Wasser

Es wird über aktuelle, wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und Neuentdeckungen berichtet.

Thomas und Alice leben glücklich in einem kleinen Küstenort. Doch eines Tages rückt Polizei an. Eine Kommissarin verdächtigt Thomas, ein lange gesuchter Familienmörder zu sein. In Belgien, einem der am dichtesten besiedelten Länder der Welt, vermutet man echte Natur nicht mehr. Dennoch ist in der von Autobahnen zerschnittenen Welt noch wilde Natur von überraschendem Reichtum zu entdecken - man muss nur Augen dafür haben.

Wenn der erste Frost die belgische Landschaft mit einem weißen Schleier überzieht, kehrt Ruhe ein. Aber Kraniche, Sperlinge, Habichte, Wanderfalken, Hirschkäfer, Libellen, Spinnen und Hornissen bleiben trotz der Kälte aktiv.

George and Freddie love having fun. After a hearty breakfast, they fill their day with family 'eggsperiments', art and even set up an obstacle course for Mum and Dad to complete. It looks easy at first until they learn they have to do it blindfolded.
Jen amazes Small with her tap-dancing skills. Small finds out how ginger is grown and ground. Plus, the two chefs cheer up a lonely gingerbread man with some gingerbread friends.

Hearing dog Diesel is on an important mission, to wake his teenage owner Rayane, who's deaf, up in time for his football trial. There's a big match tomorrow, and Rayane really wants to be picked for the team. It's the summer holidays, so Rayane and Diesel have been sleeping in. Diesel needs to be on high alert! Diesel's superears are trained to alert Rayane to important sounds he might miss. Diesel is Rayane's ears.
Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet some elands and colobus monkeys.
pr.sub: Aneeshwar and Lizzie: Eland and Colobus Monkey

pr.d: Aneeshwar and Lizzie meet two amazing animals and reveal a surprising connection between them in the wild. This time, it's elands and colobus monkeys.
Explore the things that people might carry in their bags and why. Meet people from different backgrounds and jobs to find out more about them.
The After School Club hosts its first talent show, but when the key to a snack treasure chest goes missing, Waffle steps up to save the day.
Oona and Baba get stuck on the cliff during a storm.

Twinkle discovers an army of marching ants taking seeds from her vegetable garden. When all attempts to stop them fail, she and Yukee try to find a way to get the ants marching to a different beat and away from her garden.
Lu, Gus, Declan, Biba, Barnaby, and Elodie have fun at the playground on a dry day, but Elodie ends up leaving Lu feeling sad when she forgets her promise to push her on the swing.
The Piggies wonder what's more fun: playing outside or a board game. So, Charlie builds a giant outdoor board game, but their competitiveness ruins the fun!
When there is nothing there to count and none is the amount, nobody does it better than Zero. Learn about the number zero.

With a dressing up box it must be showtime! B, O and X discover a dressing up box that is filled with everything they need to put on a performance of Sleeping Beauty, except for something to sleep on.
Justin and George meet a friend for gymnastics, and Mr Tumble attempts a very big jump.
Justin has an energetic trip to the gymnastics centre with his friend. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble attempts a very big jump.
Dipsy and Laa-Laa drive to the Hidey Hup in the Tubby Car. They meet Tinky Winky and Po and the Teletubbies go on the Tubby Uppy Downy together.

Ranger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how seaweed plays such an important role in the environment. They find out that seaweed can be a shelter for lots of sea creatures, a great place for seabirds to look for food to eat, and that seaweed helps provide some of the oxygen we breathe. On the way, they see what they can spot in a rock pool and have a picnic of some snacks made from seaweed!
Maddie is looking at useful lights. She finds out how traffic lights work, making sure that vehicles can safely travel through a road junction.
Motorbike rider Grace shows off three amazing machines that are pedal powered. Grace drives a pedal car, shows off a pedal glider and then has a race with Speedy on a water bike.

Mrs Farrell and Miss Gerrard have Kindness Day, so the class show how they can be extra kind. Jessica and Orla draw lovely pictures for the teachers, and Sam helps Solomon with his yoghurt at lunchtime.
When a gigantic saltwater crocodile wanders into freezing waters, the Octonauts must figure out how to get the predator back to his warm water home - without anyone getting hurt.
When Benjamin takes charge of a strawberry harvest raid on Mr McGregor's garden, he learns that it's harder than he thought to be a good leader.
pr.sub: The Tale of Benjamin's Strawberry Raid

pr.d: Norrie is having fun looking at nature in the garden. When Roly wants to join in, she tells him he needs to be really quiet, but he gets overexcited, shouting so loudly that he scares a lovely butterfly away. Norrie is put out because Roly did the opposite of what she said. When Roly asks what an opposite is, Norrie struggles to explain. Luckily, Duggee has his Opposites Badge and helps the squirrels understand by using lots of fun examples.
The Piris find a skeleton buried in the ice and think it's an ancient ancestor. But after a series of strange discoveries, things take an unexpected turn.
Supertato, Carrot, Broccoli and Chilli are playing when, suddenly, they hear a scream and discover an upset Evil Pea in her freezer. They soon find out that her throne has been stolen.
The farmer calls the FBI to investigate the weird happenings on the farm. As he shows the agents all the chaos, the Weasy Family watch and remember all of their craziest adventures.
The Weasy family dress up as aliens to trick the suspicious farmer.
Mojo's got the perfect top for digging up the bones of a Swoppitus Rex. But could an actual dinosaur still be alive under Jackson's field, or is it a case of mistaken identity?
Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.
Mum bans the girls from saying the word 'dunny' because it's not a word the Queen of England would use, but the kids try and trick her into saying it anyway.
Spark isn't feeling well, but Madam Dragon insists he is fine - just over-excited about his lesson. Zog's intuition tells him Madam Dragon is wrong, but can he tell her?
Dr Ollie forgets who he asked to play the wizard in his play! Ava's memory-jogging machine helps him recall, but things get confusing at the nursery.
Waffle has so much fun on a doggy play date at Mr Willow's house that he decides to stay for a sleepover! The Brooklyn-Bells miss Waffle and can't wait for his return.
Rafi's superhero wish teaches her that teamwork is the greatest power of all.

JoJo is having a sleepover at Gran Gran's house and wonders why the moon is a funny shape. Gran Gran explains to JoJo why the moon appears to change shape in the night sky, and together they make a moon diary for JoJo to take home to Mummy and Daddy.
pr.sub: Autumn: It's Time to See the Moon

pr.d: Nick creates a Podcast Song about a brave penguin called Ruby who was born with one wing.
Major Clanger, Mother, Granny and the Soup Dragon go on a trip to the stars leaving the Iron Chicken in charge of their children. What could possibly go wrong?
MeMo and BaBa realise that spreading a little happiness can make them happy too.

Get ready for a magical bedtime with Jonathan Bailey.

His lack of grief arouses suspicion, investigations are made, and they reveal some unsettling facts - he has a track record of deception, and his pharmaceutical expertise may suggest an alternative explanation for his wife's death.
A twisted killer murdered prostitutes and left their bodies in plain sight. Evidence of treads and threads enable police to track him down.

NFL player Clay Matthews and his wife, Casey, are building their dream home and want a classy tank with subtle references to his career with the Green Bay 🏈 [NFL] Packers.
pr.sub: Clay Matthews' Green Bay Eel Tank

pr.d: The gold miners of the Yukon are back to put everything on the line in the hopes of striking it rich. With new miners, new claims and new machines, the stakes are higher than ever.
Scott steps up to challenge Mike for the Captain's spot, but all Skipper Andy sees is his deck start to disintegrate.
Captain Phil sadly loses his battle for life while the fleet are out battling a massive storm, but once they find out they celebrate his life - crabber style.
Texas Game Wardens patrol the Mexico border for illegal fishing and hunt a trapper who may be selling live coyotes up north. An undercover job reveals a serious crime.
Texas Game Wardens check hunting camps at the height of deer season. On the Rio Grande, they stop a Mexican fisherman from poaching in U.S. waters.
A look at how Aquavit is made, how motorcycle leathers are made, and how the St. Patrick's Cathedral in New York is cleaned.
A look at how they build a port ready to receive huge container ships, how they make 28 million plastic bags a day, and how do they blow the glass to make baubles.
A look at how they make the world's most expensive vinegar, how they keep divers warm in the freezing ocean, and how they build a plane that can fly upside down.
How do they forge super steel to make a car lighter, greener and safer? And, how do they shear Australia's eighty million sheep every Spring?
In Northern California, the Raneys give a masterclass on rebuilding from scratch when they help a family whose homestead was destroyed in a devastating wildfire.
A family in Idaho suffers from a cabin on the verge of collapse and predator threat to 100 chickens. The Raneys set about making it liveable.
Mike finds an Alfa Romeo GTV with some fails, but he reckons Elvis can sort it. Can he get it ready for an Italian road trip to re-create the GTV Cup?
Parker buys a new plant to mine the promising Road Cut. Tony's crew runs bedrock to keep gold flowing. Greg and Buzz decode mysterious black pay dirt.

As America marks its 250th birthday, reports of Revolutionary War ghosts draw Phil, Heather and Jack Osbourne to historic battlefields in Pennsylvania. Their investigation uncovers unsettling encounters at some of the nation's most storied sites.

Josh Gates hunts for the truth behind the world's most iconic and fascinating legends. Leaving no stone unturned, Josh's adventures take him around the globe and into dangerous situations as he dives in to uncover the truth behind enduring mysteries.
The captains find a rare strain of red king crab in the north amid crushing ice and violent storms. Sig deploys an underwater drone to pinpoint the horde.

Mum geht zu einer Babyparty. Somit muss Dad das abendliche Programm vor dem Zubettgehen übernehmen. Jedoch vermisst Bluey schnell ihre Mum und ist traurig. Daraufhin lässt Dad sich jede Menge Spiele einfallen, um Bluey abzulenken.
Das Spidey-Team sucht im Meer nach einem Seeungeheuer. / Kobold-Glibber verschmutzt den Fluss.
pr.sub: Die Suche nach dem Seeungeheuer / Die Glibberfabrik

pr.d: Amber fühlt sich ausgeschlossen. Layla freundet sich mit Amber an.

Chiffen ist ganz aufgeregt, als er im Zauberwald ein geheimnisvolles Ei findet. Wem gehört es nur? Darly und Loomis helfen ihm, es zu seiner Mutter zurückzubringen, doch der Abschied fällt Chiffen schwer.
pr.sub: Chiffen und sein Küken; Alle für Klein-Muffelmotz

pr.d: Dracoon nimmt sein Lieblingsspielzeug mit auf ein Abenteuer.

Als Haleys Vorgesetzter nach einem erfolgversprechenden Rezept für ein Produkt aus Chilischoten sucht, wittert Haley ihre Chance. Sie versucht, Gloria vom Verkauf ihres Salsa-Dips zu überzeugen. Derweil hat Mitch eine Überraschung für Cam.

Als Dede unerwartet zu Besuch kommt, sprechen Mitch und Cam über die Rolle, die Mutter Pritchett in ihrem Leben spielt. Unterdessen warten Phil, Luke, Haley und Alex auf den richtigen Moment, um Claire schlechte Nachrichten zu überbringen.

Trotz Gregs Belehrungen verliert Dharma einen teuren Ring, den ihr Kitty zur Hochzeit geschenkt hatte. Nach langem Suchen kann sie den verdreckten Ring doch noch finden und bringt ihn zu einem Juwelier. Dort erlebt sie eine Überraschung.
Larry bekommt die Gelegenheit einen Buchladen, den er sehr mag, zu kaufen. Greg will beweisen, dass UFOs nicht existieren.
pr.sub: Die Wahrheit ist nirgendwo da draußen

pr.d: Dharma bietet Gregs früherer Sekretärin ihre Hilfe an, da sie große Probleme bei der Suche eines Jobs hat.

Schmidt, Coach und Winston freuen sich über die neuen attraktiven Nachbarinnen Michelle und Laurie. Aber natürlich versauen die drei gleich das erste Aufeinandertreffen total. Sie wollen es beim nächsten Mal besser machen.

Am Morgen nach ihrer Trennung versuchen Jess und Nick, dies vor ihren Mitbewohnern geheim zu halten. Winston schafft die Aufnahmeprüfung für die Polizeiakademie und erwartet von seinen Freunden eine besondere Belohnung.

Als Dede unerwartet zu Besuch kommt, sprechen Mitch und Cam über die Rolle, die Mutter Pritchett in ihrem Leben spielt. Unterdessen warten Phil, Luke, Haley und Alex auf den richtigen Moment, um Claire schlechte Nachrichten zu überbringen.

Mrs. Münzberg hat zu einem Ball in der Villa geladen und fürchtet, dass ihre Tanzkünste nicht ausreichen. Binikos bemüht sich, aus Mrs. Münzberg eine bessere Tänzerin zu machen. Doch alle seine Bemühungen haben keinen Erfolg.

Als Kätzchen Taffy verkleidet, will sich der immer hungrige Waschbär Zecki Zugang zu Mrs. Münzbergs teurer Villa und damit ihrem gut gefüllten Kühlschrank verschaffen. Aber er rechnet dabei nicht mit Mrs. Münzbergs scharfsinnigem Hund Bentley.

Um als Oberhaupt des Münzberg-Clans die Verantwortung für das enorme Familienvermögen zu übernehmen, muss Mrs. Münzberg beweisen, dass sie bereit ist. Als sie eine Puppe aus ihrer Kindheit findet, benimmt sie sich wieder wie ein Kind.

Benedikt soll diesmal einen echten T-Rex streicheln. Aber abgesehen davon, dass so ein fleischfressender Tyrannosaurus nicht gerade ein Kuscheltier ist, sind die Dinosaurier doch schon vor einigen Millionen Jahren ausgestorben.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: In der Schule stellen die Eltern ihre Berufe vor. Als Chloés Armreif aus ihrer Tasche verschwindet, versucht Sabrinas Vater Roger, ein Polizist, zu helfen. Doch als Monsieur Bourgeois ihn feuert, nutzt Hawk Moth Rogers Verbitterung aus.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Cat Noir und Ladybug müssen Kim retten, der am Valentinstag in Dark Cupid verwandelt wurde.

Die eigentlich unzertrennliche Freundschaft zwischen Liff und Barry wird durch ein Geschenk auf eine harte Probe gestellt. Darüber hinaus verirrt sich Liff mit der gesamten Clique im Wald und erlebt mit ihnen eine schreckliche Begegnung.
pr.sub: Das Freundiläum / So was von Table Town

pr.d: Cricket und seine Familie ziehen vom Land in die Großstadt, was zuerst einen großen Kulturschock auslöst. Doch Cricket ist optimistisch und naiv, was ihn schnell neue Freunde finden lässt. Zusammen erleben sie viele Abenteuer in der großen Stadt.
Auf der Suche nach Informationen über ihr Lieblingseis verliert sich Tilly im Internet.

pr.t: Mystery Lane - Ein Fall für Clever und Bro
pr.d: Der Herrscher der Londoner Tiere ist besorgt über eine Reihe von Katzenentführungen.

Nicki, Experiment 276, wird aktiviert: Es schleicht sich in Träume ein und verwandelt sie in Alpträume. Lilo ist deprimiert und legt sich hin, um den ganzen Tag zu schlafen. Natürlich schleicht sich sofort Experiment 276 in ihr Ohr und verbreitet in ihren Träumen Angst und Schrecken. Um das gefährliche Experiment einzufangen, transportiert sich Jumba mit Pleakley und Stitch in Lilos Traum.

Carl bittet Monty, ihm dabei zu helfen, dass sich Major Monogram endlich einmal bei ihm bedankt. Unterdessen glaubt Candace, endlich einen Weg gefunden zu haben, die Abenteuer ihrer Brüder auffliegen zu lassen. Als Phineas und Ferb herausfinden, dass Candace für ihren Buchclub die "Ilias" lesen muss, stellen sie kurzerhand die legendäre Belagerung von Troja nach. Unterdessen hilft Perry versehentlich Dr. Doofenschmirtz dabei, seine Wohnung zu entrümpeln.
pr.sub: Montys Plan; Die Trojaner schlagen zurück

pr.d: Bingo ist völlig davon überzeugt, dass der Osterhase sie wie im vergangenen Jahr vergessen hat. Bluey findet daraufhin allerdings eine Reihe von Hinweisen, die sie auf eine großartige Schatzsuche mit zahlreichen Ostereiern führen.
Bluey freut sich auf ihr eigenes Zimmer. Doch als Schlafenszeit ist, vermisst sie Bingo.

Als Mama einen Hindernisparcours im Garten lediglich zum Spaß an der Sache einrichtet, will Papa ein Rennen veranstalten. Dementsprechend haben die Kinder nun Mut geschlossen, um mit allen Mitteln als Gewinner herauszugehen.

Bluey lernt von Bingo, wie wichtig es ist, ein Versprechen einzuhalten, das man gibt. Sie bricht immer wieder ihre Versprechen, doch als sie Bingo dabei zusieht, wie sehr er sich auf die Worte von Mama verlassen kann, ändert sich ihre Meinung.
Bingo hilft seiner Mutter dabei, ein Omelett für Papas Geburtstagsfrühstück zu machen.

pr.t: Miraculous - Geschichten von Ladybug und Cat Noir
pr.d: Die Schüler Marinette und Adrien erhalten die Fähigkeit, sich in die Superhelden Ladybug und Cat Noir zu verwandeln und können dadurch das Glück und das Pech manipulieren. Sie wollen dem Bösewicht Hawk Moth das Handwerk legen.

Zusammen mit Äffchen Abu macht der Straßenjunge Aladdin die Gassen der Basare unsicher. Aber er träumt von einem besseren Leben. Vor allem seit er Jasmin, die Tochter des Sultans, kennengelernt hat. Plötzlich ändert sich Aladdins Leben schlagartig, denn er gelangt in den Besitz einer Wunderlampe, die es wirklich in sich hat: Sie beherbergt einen gigantischen, unendlich ausgeflippten Flaschengeist namens Dschinni, der seinem Besitzer drei Wünsche erfüllen kann.

Tief unten in der Stille des Ozeans lebt Arielle, die Meerjungfrau. Sie ist die Tochter von Triton, dem Unterwasserkönig, aber anstatt ihren höfischen Pflichten nachzukommen, geht sie lieber zusammen mit dem kleinen Fisch Fabius auf Entdeckungsreise an die Oberfläche und sammelt Schätze von den Menschen. Arielle wünscht sich nämlich heimlich, selbst ein Mensch zu sein. Bei einem Unwetter rettet Arielle Prinz Eric das Leben und von da an ist es dann um sie geschehen.

Olaf erzählt die Geschichte von "Arielle, die Meerjungfrau" in seiner eigenen Interpretation. Dabei nimmt er die Figurenrollen von Arielle, Triton, Scuttle und auch dem Koch Louis ein sowie der bösen Meerhexe Ursula in bester Olaf-Manier.

Percy erhält den Auftrag, den Herrscherblitz von Zeus zurückzubringen. Dieser Auftrag ist äußerst wichtig, um einen Krieg zwischen den Göttern zu verhindern. Infolgedessen möchte er von Annabeth und Grover in die Unterwelt begleitet werden.
pr.sub: Wir besuchen das Emporium der Gartenzwerge

pr.d: Die Jagd auf die Helden wird intensiver, als Percy, Annabeth und Grover von Mächten gejagt werden, die schlimmer sind, als sie angenommen haben. Sie verletzen sich und suchen Zuflucht im St. Louis Arch, wo sie überlegen, ob sie um Hilfe rufen sollen.
pr.sub: Ich stürze mich in den Tod

pr.d: Jess und Cece werden per Zufall zu einer Party des legendären Musikstars Prince eingeladen. Da Nick, Schmidt, Winston und Coach sich diesen Spaß nicht entgehen lassen wollen, versuchen sie, sich irgendwie in Prince' Partyvilla einzuschleusen.

Nick trifft zufällig auf seine Ex-Freundin Caroline, was ihn in eine unangenehme Situation bringt. Jess will Nick davon überzeugen, dass er und Caroline trotz allem Freunde sein können und stellt ihm deshalb ihren Ex-Freund Berkeley vor.
Als Jess' wilde Schwester Abby zu Besuch kommt, wird die ganze WG ins Chaos gestürzt. Derweil bittet Schmidt Nick, ihn zu einer Bar Mizwa zu begleiten, um ihm dabei zu helfen, eine Frau aufzureißen.

Espionage thriller about a plot to make America appear responsible for a communist nuclear strike on North Korea. The seasoned commanding officer of the USS Caine, a World War II minesweeper-destroyer, is forced to relinquish control of his ship in a mutiny on the high seas by officers who consider him mentally unfit. The dramatic court-martial that follows exposes the complex motives behind the incident at sea.

Sweeping epic about three sons raised on a Montana ranch by their father, a colonel who has turned his back on the army after the Indian Wars. Though the destinies of the boys are very different, two forces impact on each of their lives: the Great War in Europe and the love of a young woman. Covering several decades, the action ranges from majestic Montana to the battlefields of Europe and adventure on the high seas.

The winning chefs from all eight regions must battle it out for the honour of a spot on 2018's 'Feast To Say Thank You' banquet menu, celebrating 70 years of the NHS, one of Britain's most prized institutions.

The chefs must prepare fish courses, and after some exceptionally high-scoring dishes in the starter round, everyone is desperate to deliver perfection. Once again, the chefs present their innovative, witty and heart-warming creations.

It's main course day and with only two spots remaining on the banquet menu, the competition is fierce. Both chefs and judges alike are amazed at the high standard of cooking and an incredible number of 10s are dished out as the chefs serve up venison, rabbit, duck, beef, lamb and pork for scrutiny.

It's dessert day and with just one place remaining at the banquet feast, each chef is giving everything they've got for a chance to say thank you to the heroic NHS staff. All the chefs have significantly re-worked or re-invented their desserts since the regional heats, proving that they'll do everything they can in a bid for that final winning spot.

It's the grand finale as the winning chefs cook their dishes at a banquet for the heroes of the NHS. Having arrived at St Bartholomew's Hospital, the chefs are shown the incredible location for event, the almost three-hundred-year-old Great Hall.
Competing for the top spot are 3 new chefs to the competition representing some of the most exciting culinary talent from London, Paul Walsh, Luke Selby and Ben Marks.

The largest football stadium in the United States is turned into an ice hockey rink. Plus, robots are programmed to mass-produce cars.
Over a century of Italian craftsmanship is squeezed into an accordion. Workers create callers that make duck hunters sound just like their prey.
The team find lost relics of bygone times, including stools made for child-workers at an old hat dyer's factory and some classic fairground art.
The team hunt for items their clients will love. In Lancashire Viki buys a set of laboratory lamps, in London Serkan nabs a 1930s papier mâché lion.
Paul wants to buy a Citroen DS, but Drew has major reservations. This banged up classic car is priced at £6,500- will the guys take it on.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including automotive fuel pumps, cricket bats, change machines and ductile iron pipe.
More everyday items are put under the microscope as we discover how they are made, including wooden barrels, fire hydrants, automotive seats and cathode ray tubes.
Teleshopping.
Teleshopping.
The force is strong with paper conservator Ashleigh as she restores an original Star Wars poster. And upholsterer Ray updates a pair of 1960s designer chairs.
Drew visits a hip dealer in Manchester, haggles with a windmill manager in Kent and seeks artefact redemption at a Somerset abbey. Plus, he moves shop after 10 years.
Drew is in Scotland to see a Victorian theatre in Aberdeen and the remote town of Rothes. Tee shows him how to do a deal at a steam railway in Devon.
Permit delays force the Poseidon Crew off road as they try to survive the season. Plus, the Dust Devils gamble big in the hope of finding fine gold.
Marcus and Linden fear a flat battery could leave them stuck in the outback for days. Plus, Shane and Russell attempt to get their season on track.
The Bushmen's new claim turns dangerous, forcing Rod and Les to choose between riches and safety. Plus, the Young Guns demolish their old mine.
Chris Cheal's dream of two mining teams struggles to launch. Meanwhile, the Blacklighters gamble on a new claim to break a month-long opal drought.
Drew visits a huge antiques warehouse in Belfast. On the lookout for 18th century Irish furniture, he's excited to spot a mahogany chest of drawers.
Henry and Fuzz head to Bristol to see Robert's 1950 Austin Atlantic. Faded and forgotten for years, can they revive this bold British classic.
The boys visit Rob, who has an impressive collection of vintage British bikes. They find a BSA Bantam and a classic 1930's Austin Ten automobile.
Henry and Fuzz visit Paul in the Malvern Hills, a man with a perfectly maintained collection of Japanese motorbikes including a Honda 750 Four.

pr.t: Find It, Fix It, Flog It
pr.d: Henry and Simon are in Buckinghamshire to rummage through a storage unit full of potential. They pick up a sliding cupboard and a cubbyhole shelving unit.
Angus unearths some family fortunes at comedy legend Les Dennis' home. Then, he checks out a selection of movie memorabilia at Sherrie Hewson's house.
Huge Bids For A Rare Collection. Angus uncovers a loft stashed with bizarre but highly valuable collectables. Plus, a set of rare stamps deliver a big cash windfall at auction.
Can Margie Cooper make it a clean sweep as she and Mark Hill head for the heart of Edinburgh in a 1980 MGB Roadster.
Actress Helen Flanagan asks Angus to sell some Corrie keepsakes and haute couture, while comedian Bobby Davro brings coins and sporting memorabilia.
The experts are entranced by a three-dimensional portrait of a Hindu goddess. Plus, they revive a birdwatcher's binoculars and a broken silver locket.
The team revive a rusty chrome calendar ornament. They restore a 1930s schoolbook from Trinidad and a sweet little wind instrument called an ocarina.
Workers manufacture toilets that massage and blow-dry. The Navy tests a pilotless helicopter. A jackhammer that doesn't cause the shakes is built.
The secrets behind keeping the cars of Daytona on the track for 24 hours of racing are revealed. The sweetest sugarcane is turned into Caribbean rum.

With their armies fully engaged on the battlegrounds, the Allied and Axis powers focused their efforts to develop new weapons and new strategies to deliver a knockout blow to the enemy and bring about a quick end to the conflict.
After Hitler's gamble in the East fails, the Soviet Union starts to slowly push back and grow.

By early 1944, Hitler had long been expecting an Allied attack on north-western France, but his problem was knowing when and where it would come. This episode has a look at the Allied operations Bodyguard and Overlord.
Concentrates on Hitler's attempts to shift the balance of power back in his favour.
The war in the Pacific against Japan was a savage hand-to-hand, island-to-island struggle, fought by new specialist fighting units like the valiant Chindits.
Allied forces converge on Germany, uncovering the horrors of Belsen and Buchenwald, before pushing towards Berlin, where Adolf Hitler is clinging to power in his last desperate days.

pr.t: Heroes on Deck: World War II on Lake Michigan
pr.d: The US Navy trained nearly 15,000 pilots on Lake Michigan from 1942-1945, resulting in the sinking of more than 100 classic World War II fighters and dive bombers.
The documentary details the Bismarck's search and sinking, featuring naval historians and Angus Konstam.

In April 1945, as Stalin's Red Army approach from the east and the western Allied forces quickly approach through France and Belgium, Adolf Hitler awaits his fate in his bunker, reflecting on the mistakes that lost him the war.

Hungarian Jews Magda Brown and George Brent, who survived the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp as teenagers, reveal the human aspects of survival, resistance, chance, and luck in the face of Nazi tyranny.
No description available · EPGTalk.com
Hoping to find a sense of normalcy, six female Holocaust survivors immigrate to America, get married and raise children.

A look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including a baby doll, Elsa Ury's suitcase, camp children's tales, the gas chamber door, Karl Hocker's album, a cracked thermos flask, and an SS Licence Plate.
A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, a former Nazi concentration and extermination camp and the world's largest cemetery.

A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau including a sketchbook, various stolen objects, a little white house, Hoss's gallows, Roma portraits, and a double portrait.

A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including a little shoe and suitcase, the central sauna, collar tabs, Bilderbuch and Sonderkommando photos.
A sobering look at some of the personal items and belongings left behind in Auschwitz Birkenau, including soup kettles, a snuff box, the crematorium furnace, the camp model and a Totenbuch.

A documentary that sheds light on the Holocaust experience from the perspective of six women imprisoned in the Auschwitz-Birkenau concentration camp. The film demonstrates the Nazis' failure to crush the will of Jews. The women profiled do not dwell on the physical and emotional hardships. Instead, they speak of camp families and faith, and the ways in which they tried to encourage one another and retain their humanity in the face of unimaginable evil.

Investigative documentary exploring the construction of the Mauthausen concentration camp. In 1938, Hitler ordered the construction of the camp, one of the deadliest in history. Some 200,000 people would be deported there. Over 120,000 would perish.
In York, Professor Alice Roberts takes part in a Viking battle, meets the metal detectorists behind one of the UK's greatest archaeological finds, and gets her hands on Viking poo.
Alice discovers things at Norwich Castle Museum which highlight facts about Tudor life, Anglo-Saxon childbirth rituals, and the Pompeii of the Bronze Age.
A look back at the best archaeological findings of 2014, including the Barrow Clump, Ipplepen and Winchester sites.
Kevin Sempé dives in search of wrecks harking back to the Roman Empire's greatness. The journey begins with the Nave Romana.
pr.sub: Shipwrecked Sailors Of The Roman Empire

pr.d: Kevin Sempé explores the bay of Saint-Pierre in Martinique, where ships smouldered and sank following the devastating volcanic eruption of 1902.

Alice tells the story of Norman England by studying the history of Winchester, Britain's most Norman city. Alice attempts to storm a castle in chain mail, investigates the origins of modern surgery and tucks in to an appetising eel pie.
In Norwich, the UK's most Tudor city, Professor Alice Roberts learns about religious intolerance, uncovers the Norwich FC canary's origins and experiences humiliating Tudor justice.

Andy visits Worcestershire to honour his childhood rock hero, explores a gender-biased cave, and unravels the mystery of "Who Put Bella in the Wych Elm?" He later meets a treasure hunter and enjoys May Day Morris dancing.

Andy and Dr Kate Cherrell explore Nottingham's eerie museum with creepy dolls and a haunted hearse. They visit the rumoured haunted National Justice Museum and learn about Robin Hood and a cursed galleon at an old pub.

A look at the biggest collection of Roman writing tablets in Britain, giving insight into what Roman London was really like. Off the coast of Kent, a dive into the English Channel reveals the biggest marine excavation since the Mary Rose, an 18th-century East India Company ship packed with silver.

Alice discovers the well-preserved writing tablets, swords and domestic items left by Romans at Vindolanda during a time of British rebellion. On the Scottish island of Iona, there are traces of a long-lost monastery and pilgrimage site that was originally built by the legendary Saint Columba, and has been compared to Jerusalem. In the east of Scotland, a weapons hoard belonging to a wealthy Bronze Age warrior is unearthed.
Dan Jones visits the heart of the English countryside to explore Arundel Castle and the dramatic history of the Earls of Arundel.

Dan Jones visits Lancaster Castle to explore its grisly history of crime and punishment, including the infamous Lancashire Witches trials and the martyrdom of the Jesuit priest Saint Edmund Arrowsmith.
In York, Professor Alice Roberts takes part in a Viking battle, meets the metal detectorists behind one of the UK's greatest archaeological finds, and gets her hands on Viking poo.
Alice enjoys a Roman feast in Britain's most Roman city, Chester. She examines a radical theory on the Romans' plans for the city and explores an incredible archaeological find deep underground.
Kevin dives into the blue waters of the Caribbean to find the relics that litter the sea floor from piracy's heyday in the region.
pr.sub: The True Story of the Pirates of the Caribbean

pr.d: Kevin embarks on a challenging dive in the Atlantic Ocean to explore a battleship that saved the Northern Navy in the American Civil War.
pr.sub: Uss Monitor, Clash Of The Ironclads

pr.d: Explore how the Polynesians spread across the Pacific and examine the cultures they took with them while constructing elaborate temples to their beliefs.

The Inca, a vast late medieval civilisation in Peru and nearby regions, fell to Spanish conquest in 1533. Despite agricultural and architectural feats, they lacked military tech and disease immunity to resist invaders.

Robert hat italienische Wurzeln und will nach Italien ziehen. Doch seine Frau Laura befürchtet, als Außenseiterin dazustehen. Als die beiden nach einem Zuhause suchen, stellen sie schnell fest, dass Roberts Plan Laura unberücksichtigt lässt.

Ein erfolgreiches Paar zieht aus New York auf die hügelige Karibikinsel St. Martin. Das neue Heim soll ihr Traumhaus mit ihrem Arbeitsplatz vereinen. Doch die beiden haben unterschiedliche Vorstellungen ihres neuen Zuhauses.
pr.sub: Vom Big Apple nach Saint Martin

pr.d: Vor fünf Jahren begannen Cab und Lisa, die Halbinsel Baja in Mexiko zu besuchen. Sie waren fasziniert von den Stränden, den Weinbergen und der Nähe zu San Diego. Als sie jedoch nach Immobilien suchten, zeigten sich ihre verschiedenen Vorstellungen.
Diese Sendung wirbt für verschiedene Produkte, die man sich bequem nach Hause schicken lassen kann.

Donna und Curtis wollen sich mit ihrem Lottogewinn in Massachusetts zur Ruhe setzen und suchen ein Haus möglichst nah am See und nicht weiter als 45 Minuten von Hopkinton entfernt. Häuser in dieser Lage sind allerdings sehr gefragt.

Die jungvermählten Berufstätigen und Tierliebhaber Sophie, Tim und ihre beiden Hunde wollen unbedingt aus seiner engen Wohnung herauskommen, aber angesichts ihrer Wunschliste bedarf es eines kleinen Wunders, um eine perfekte Immobilie zu finden.
Katie und Michael träumen von einem geräumigeren Zuhause für sich und ihre drei Töchter.

Ein verlobtes junges Paar sucht in einer schicken Gegend in Florida nach einem renovierungsbedürftigen Haus. Das zukünftige Zuhause am Wasser soll noch vor der Hochzeit renoviert werden, damit genug Platz für die Familienplanung ist.

Eine Familie begibt sich auf die Suche nach einem barrierefreien Haus in den Outer Banks von North Carolina. Die Gegend ist normalerweise sehr teuer, doch die Familie hat Glück. Doch nun stehen einige Renovierungsarbeiten an.

Eine Familie verlässt ihr angemietetes Ferienhaus und will stattdessen ein neues Traumhaus auf Rhode Island kaufen. Die Käufer finden ein passendes Anwesen. Dieses benötigt allerdings einige Renovierungsarbeiten, die ans Geld gehen.

Inmitten des historischen Stadtteils Sunset Hills haben Tamaras neue Kunden ein Haus zum Schnäppchenpreis ergattert. Das zweistöckige 400 m² große Anwesen im Tudor-Stil stammt aus dem Jahr 1955 und muss dringend renoviert werden.

Tamaras Bekannter Marc hat in einer begehrten Gegend ein baufälliges und unbewohnbares Haus erworben. Er will es sanieren und wieder verkaufen und Tamara hilft dabei, der preiswerten Villa den Glanz zu verleihen, den sie verdient.

Ein alleinerziehender Vater möchte für sich und seine drei Töchter ein Traumhaus errichten, das einem Märchenschloss gleicht. Diese umfangreiche Renovierung steckt voller einzigartiger Designüberraschungen, die sich für Könige eignen.

Die 79-jährige Charmaine hat über Jahrzehnte Erinnerungsstücke gesammelt, die ihr kleines Stadthaus überfüllen. Ihre Tochter Hetty will mit Enkelin Maya zu Besuch kommen, doch dafür muss Charmaine sich von ihren Sachen trennen, um Raum zu schaffen.
Kanoa Lloyd und das Team helfen der Mutter eines behinderten Sohnes, die im Chaos versinkt.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: In Arkansas benötigt eine Siedlerfamilie dringend Hilfe. Im Spätwinter schlägt das Wetter in den unwirtlichen Ozark Mountains gnadenlos zu. Ashli und Chris Curry sind die Aufgaben längst über den Kopf gewachsen: Es mangelt an Trinkwasser.

pr.t: Home Rescue - Wohnen in der Wildnis
pr.d: Jay und Pattie Crum haben sich ihren Traum erfüllt und sind auf eine entlegene Ranch mitten in der Wildnis Montanas gezogen. Doch ihr Grundstück ist nur über einen 16 Kilometer langen Feldweg zu erreichen, der regelmäßig von Felsen oder Baumstämmen blockiert wird. Da Jay an Epilepsie leidet, sitzt das Paar bei möglichen medizinischen Notfällen praktisch in der Falle. Die Outdoor-Experten aus Alaska eilen den Crums zur Hilfe, um sie bei der Sicherung ihrer Lebensgrundlage zu unterstützen.

Chase Morrill muss zusammen mit seinem Team in West Bath an einem Auftrag arbeiten. Und die Liste der Aufgaben ist endlos: Fenster, Sanitäranlagen, eine Küche und Schränke - all das für das künftige Urlaubsdomizil von Tina Seners.

Rod Hiltz ist ein Naturbursche. Er genießt die ruhige und entspannende Zeit im Grünen. Das spiegelt auch seine Immobilie wider. Doch es gibt ein Manko: Er muss immer durch den Wald laufen, um zum Plumpsklo zu gelangen. Das soll ein Ende haben.

Jack beginnt seine Reise in Nebraska und besichtigt ein aufwendig renoviertes Raketensilo. Danach besucht er ein märchenhaftes Cottage mit Hollywood-Vergangenheit und entdeckt zum Abschluss in Las Vegas ein außergewöhnliches Paradies für Autofans.

Martin Roberts meets one of two young brothers busy building a property portfolio in Bolsover, Derbyshire, while Dion Dublin checks out a three-bedroom semi in Wolverhampton, and Lucy Alexander is impressed by plans to convert a two-bedroom, fire-damaged terraced house in London's Plaistow into a smart five-bedroom property.

Dion Dublin has a hair-raising experience at a barber's in Rochdale, Lancashire, while Martin Roberts looks round a great bungalow in Alsager, Cheshire, and Lucy Alexander sees all the potential in a piece of land in Eccles in Kent.

Martin Roberts visits a house in Otterton, Devon, which is given a stunning transformation to match the views from the windows; Lucy Alexander looks round a small one-bedroom flat in Tottenham, London; and Dion Dublin peers into a building in Alvaston, Derby, which is in a dangerous state of disrepair.

Lucy Alexander is in Welling in the London Borough of Bexley looking round a three-bed semi in need of lots of work, Dion Dublin is in Basford, Nottingham, where a three-bedroom terraced house also requires a major revamp, and Martin Roberts hears plans from a father-and-son team who plan to knock down their auction property in Callington, Cornwall, and start again.
Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin visit a one-bedroom flat in Catford, London, a large house near the River Mersey and a semi-detached property in Alvaston in Derby.

An end-terrace house in Alfreton in Derby bought by two brothers, a mid-terrace on the coast at Seaham in County Durham and a large three-storey property with a flat and shop in Taylorstown in the Rhondda Valley are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin talk to the new owners to find out what they have planned for their auction buys.

Martin Roberts falls in love with a quirky cottage in Malvern bought by a builder and his wife, Dion Dublin talks to a first-time property developer who sees her end-terrace house in Chell in Stoke-on-Trent as something for her pension pot, and Lucy Alexander meets a divorced couple who have decided to form a new union as property developers doing up a shop and flat in Dover, Kent.

A large piece of land in Ratby in Leicestershire, a terrace in Chesterton in Staffordshire and a 1930s semi with a huge garden and huge potential are all sold at auction. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the developers hoping to breathe new life into their auction buys.

A two-bedroom detached house in Basford in Nottingham, a top-floor flat in Portsmouth and a large Edwardian terrace in Crewe are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion meet the new owners and hear about their plans.

A multimillion-pound development in Farningham in Kent, an ambitious, total renovation project in Aspatria in Cumbria and a very small studio flat in Wallington in Surrey are all sold under the hammer. Martin and Lucy meet the new owners to discuss their plans.

A Victorian terrace in London's Greenwich, two flats in Chatham in Kent and a riverside inn near Great Yarmouth in Norfolk are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners and hear plans for their renovation projects.
A three-bedroom house in Borrowash in Derbyshire, another three-bedder in West Bromwich in the Midlands and a quirky four-bedroom house on the Isle of Sheppey are all sold under the hammer.

A flat in Pegswood in Northumberland, a terrace in Swadlincote in Derbyshire and a former shop in Chatham in Kent are all sold under the hammer. Martin Roberts, Lucy Alexander and Dion Dublin meet the new owners and hear their renovation plans.
A mid-terrace house in Wales, a basement office in Central London with a huge price tag and two flats in Bootle near Liverpool are all sold under the hammer.

Lucy meets a young couple expecting a baby who have to weigh up whether to live in their auction buy in Sydenham in London. Martin talks to a man and his father-in-law who have bought their first property together in Trentham near Stoke. Also, Dion meets a man who only went into property development after he retired. His latest buy is a three-bed semi in West Bromwich.

Terraced houses in Tunstall in Shropshire and Prescott in Liverpool and a large flat in Dagenham are all sold under the hammer. Martin, Lucy and Dion have a look round before hearing what the new owners have planned.

A chiropodist, two part-time gardeners and a woman who works on projects in between the school run are today's investors. They've bought property in Bullbridge in Derbyshire, Newcastle-under-Lyme in Staffordshire and Wolverhampton in the West Midlands under the hammer.

In the desert town of Socorro, New Mexico, Crystal Houston is found murdered. Just 14 months earlier in the same desert town, her sister, Stephanie, is killed in a suspicious accident.

An afternoon motorcycle ride turns into a violent road rage incident when a couple is attacked by an angry driver. And then, when a young woman working alone is robbed at knifepoint, she bravely fights back, fending off her assailant.

A strange man violently attempts to kidnap a woman's children, but a 16-year-old wrestler saves the day. And then, when a frightening cab robbery takes place in broad daylight, someone unexpected comes to the rescue.
Nurse and private investigator Nikki and Jimmy Cappello are a dynamic duo - until Jimmy suddenly goes missing.

A CEO at just 29, Jenea Harvison supports her husband as his dreams of becoming a football player falter. However, living in his wife's shadow soon proves too much for Roy Harvison, and the price will be more than one life.
When teens Zainab and Ammar fall in love, their relationship is forbidden by her father - who will stop at nothing to ensure that his rules of honour are obeyed.
When lonely teen Meagan Grunwald meets handsome felon Angel Garcia, it's love at first sight. But their whirlwind romance leaves a trail of death and devastation.
When Kamisha enlists in the Army, she never expects to find love with her commanding officer. But when war is thrown their way, can they keep their affair secret?
A married pastor proposes a polygamous relationship with his wife, but an unexpected arrival threatens their secret. How far will the trio go to uphold their vow?

A lively slumber party turns into a nightmare when a loving mother, Dianne Watts, her young daughter, and her daughter's friend, are murdered. The town of McMinnville is turned upside down, knowing there is a killer amongst them.
In Dunlap, Tennessee, a body is found on the banks of the river. Detectives piece together the unknown man's final moments to find the culprit.

During the Cold War, sinister objects were seen flying above secret military bases. Were aliens monitoring the world's nuclear arsenal?

pr.d: A ghost ship is found on a remote island, home to one of Earth's last uncontacted tribes. New evidence reveals a mysterious military compound in Russia.

Can satellite images help identify the hiding place of the Nazi Gold Train? Also, a blood-red river in Siberia points to pollution on a catastrophic scale and a discovery of a long-lost settlement rewrites the history of the Vikings in North America.

Craig and Sarah take on the US Navy's Unidentified Aerial Phenomenon videos: the 'Tic-Tac' footage, filmed from the USS Nimitz in 2004, and the 'Go-Fast' and 'Gimbal' videos filmed between 2014 and 2015 from the USS Theodore Roosevelt.

Craig and Sarah pore over every scrap of available evidence relating to the Rendlesham incident, including the audio recording made by Lieutenant Colonel Charles Halt when he and a patrol of men investigated lights in the forest that fateful night.
Governments around the world investigate UFO sightings, but many of them keep it a secret from the public.
Alien abductees reveal details about the insides of UFOs and help researchers understand how aliens live and what they want from the human race.

On a September morning in 1994, students at a Zimbabwe school witness a silver craft land in a nearby field. Numerous adults corroborate the UFO sighting, but the children are silenced. Many maintain their account of the incident is true.
60 years on, Tony's close encounter has become an obsession. Meanwhile, pilot David presents photographic evidence of the UFO he almost crashed into whilst flying near area 5.
Adam, Gwen and Julie recall personal encounters with UFOs, before experts' theories are put in doubt when we learn that each individual has time missing from their encounters.
An abandoned city in remote jungles could be the home of an ancient treasure. Also, could a mysterious stone circle be the fabled round table of King Arthur?
When experts investigate a network of tunnels rumoured to be the hiding place of lost royal treasure, they find evidence of human sacrifice for a Viking god.

Several UFOs suddenly appear above Swedish power plants and other places. Some believe that the country will soon be the target of an attack. A soldier claims to have encountered a UFO years ago and receives compensation from the US military.

A fleet of UFOs is filmed over the South China Sea, a 12,000-year-old archaeological site reveals carvings of alien, six-fingered humanoids, and a recorded confession claims that Albert Einstein made a secret visit to Roswell in 1947 to see a crashed UFO and its dead and dying occupants.
The tourist-attracting waters of Crater Lake National Park may also be the epicentre of dark and sinister forces from Native American lore that lure visitors to their deaths.
Claims of a demonic truck driver, disembodied voices, nightmarish skinwalkers and a time loop are reported in Canyonlands National Park.

The Freemasons have been meeting since the 14th century. From an ancient stoneworker's guild through to the modern era, their mythologies, beliefs, and secret rituals have inspired countless works of fiction and speculation.

Discover the mystery of Genghis Khan and the unknown location of his place of burial. It is believed that his soldiers returned his corpse to Mongolia, but legend has it that those who knew its location were murdered to keep the secret.
Scotty Moore travels to the northern coast of Peru, where archaeologists have discovered a teenage girl buried in a strange place - just outside an empty tomb.

Some believe that extraterrestrials cause atmospheric light shows and question whether they pose an imminent threat to humanity.
Did the space race stop at just the Moon? Is there any truth to rumours of a secret Space Force developed by America for missions beyond Earth's orbit?

pr.t: Border Patrol USA - Einsatz an Mexikos Grenze
pr.d: Entlang der 2.000 Meilen langen Grenze zwischen Texas und Mexiko arbeiten Grenzbeamte an einem der sensibelsten Übergänge der Welt. Täglich müssen sie den legalen Verkehr ermöglichen und gleichzeitig gefährliche Schmuggelware stoppen. Wir begleiten sie bei riskanten Einsätzen, einer heiklen Übergabe mutmaßlicher Kartellmitglieder, bewegenden Asylgeschichten und Momenten, in denen persönliche Schicksale auf harte Grenzrealität treffen.

pr.t: Border Patrol USA - Einsatz an Mexikos Grenze
pr.d: Als bei einer routinemäßigen Röntgenuntersuchung verdächtige Pakete entdeckt werden, die in den Reifen eines Kleinlasters versteckt sind, werden die Beamten skeptisch. Außerdem beschlagnahmen sie eine große Ladung Marihuana.

Über der sturmgepeitschten Nordsee wird eine Turboprop-Maschine vom Blitz getroffen. Im Cockpit fallen die Instrumente aus, das Flugzeug rast in die Tiefe, der Aufprall scheint unausweichlich. Bei der Untersuchung wird etwas Ungewöhnliches entdeckt.

Ein Privatjet befindet sich im Anflug auf den Flughafen von Akron im US-Bundesstaat Ohio. Kurz vor dem Ziel kommt es zur Katastrophe: Die Maschine knallt in ein Apartmentgebäude, alle Insassen sterben. Die Ermittler untersuchen, wie es dazu kam.

Drei Orte, drei Geschichten: In Bolivien zeigt der verschwundene Gletscher von Chacaltaya die Folgen des Klimawandels. In Belgien wird der Ort Doel zum Symbol des Widerstands. Und in Liberia erinnert ein Wolkenkratzer an das Ende der Sklaverei.

Das Dew Drop Inn in New Orleans markiert einen Fixpunkt der US-amerikanischen Musikgeschichte. Ray Charles, Little Richard und Ella Fitzgerald standen dort einst auf der Bühne. Zudem wird noch das Fort Belgica in Indonesien erkundet.

Schwerlast-Selbstfahrer gelten als Transportwunder. Ihre Motoren haben mehr als fünfhundert PS und ihr wendiges Fahrwerk besitzt acht Räder pro Achslinie. Damit können sie nicht nur vorwärts und rückwärts, sondern auch seitwärts und diagonal fahren.

pr.t: Offroad-Monster - Der steinige Weg zum eigenen Fernreisemobil
pr.d: Das Campen begann als authentischer Natururlaub und wurde Jahre später zum extravaganten Luxustourismus. Anstatt das Notwendigste mit sich zu tragen, geht nun das voll möblierte Heim mit auf Reisen. Wer sind die Besitzer dieser teuren Wohnmobile?

In dieser Sendung geht es um die gigantische Betonkonstruktion der neuen Samuel-De-Champlain-Brücke, die über dem Sankt-Lorenz-Strom im kanadischen Quebec gebaut wurde. Täglich passieren tausende Fahrzeuge auf dieser Doppelschrägseilbrücke.

Wer würde sich nicht gerne mal wie ein Superheld fühlen? Mit dem Jetsuit eines britischen Unternehmens kann man sich mühelos in die Lüfte erheben und über den Himmel jagen. Der Harvesterkopf einer finnischen Firma fällt und entastet einen Baum binnen Sekunden und unterstützt obendrein eine verantwortungsvolle Forstwirtschaft. Und ein 3D-Drucker aus Dänemark erschafft auf Knopfdruck perfekt designte Häuser aus schnelltrocknendem Beton in fast jeder gewünschten Form.

pr.d: Polizeibeamte kontrollieren routinemäßig einen Pick-up-Truck. Dort entdecken sie illegaler Substanzen. Und: Ein Krimineller soll an das mexikanische Militär übergeben werden. Die Ermittler suchen dafür eine passende Transportroute.

pr.t: Border Patrol USA - Einsatz an Mexikos Grenze
pr.d: Die Beamten der Biosicherheitskontrolle überprüfen in Laredo einige Paletten aus Mexiko. Die Kollegen überprüfen derweil ein Taxi. Darin befindet sich eine Dame, die zwei schwere Gepäckstücke bei sich hat. Die Ermittler wollen Genaueres herausfinden.

Ein Angler aus der Ukraine und eine junge Frau aus Brasilien geraten ins Visier der Zollbeamten. An den Flughäfen Auckland und Queenstown machen Beamte Funde, die die Biosicherheit des Kontinents und Landes gefährden können.
Eine Kanadierin unternimmt den Versuch, eine Katze über die Grenze zu schmuggeln und ein Niederländer wird mit einer immensen Menge an Kokain aufgegriffen.

Die neuseeländischen Grenzschutzbeamten kontrollieren drei israelische Männer, die große Mengen MDMA mit sich führen. Weiterhin stellt sich heraus, dass die Touristen sich auch anderweitig vergnügen: Sie verbringen ihre Urlaubszeit gerne in Sexklubs.

Der Versuch, Alkohol zu schmuggeln, wird von den Zollbeamten in den Häfen von Auckland vereitelt. Ein kurdischer Neuseeländer erzählt von seinen großen Abenteuern in Risikoländern und eine Französin gerät außer sich und in Rage.

Neuseelands Grenzschützer und Spürhunde überwachen Einreisende, Gepäck, Post und Fracht auf Schmuggelware und Biosicherheitsrisiken. Von Auckland bis Queenstown zeigt die Doku ihre akribische Arbeit zum Schutz der Inselnation.

Die Zollbeamten am internationalen Flughafen von Christchurch verdächtigen das Gepäck eines Kanadiers. Weiterhin bemerken sie ein ungewöhnlich farbenfrohes Päckchen aus Uganda. Schließlich belügt eine Philippinerin die Beamten.
Eine Brasilianerin verhält sich verdächtig. Ein Reisender gibt den Beamten einen hilfreichen Tipp.

Die Beamten fassen einen Chinesen, der mehr Zigaretten als erlaubt transportiert. Weiterhin verdächtigen sie eine Fracht mit Kupferdraht. Es stellt sich heraus, dass dort die Droge Crystal Meth versteckt eingeschmuggelt wird.

Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tim and Kai go crater surfing and attempt a cool new trick.
Blaze, AJ, and Starla are on their way to a Wild West Picnic. But when the Lunchbox Bandit steals everyone's lunchboxes, it's up to our Wild West Heroes to get them back.
A tiny top hat delivery leads to a dazzling day for new magician Baby Box; meanwhile, her closest friends help her perform a boppin'-and-hoppin' trick.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit, but when the King's new clothes get dirty Nanny cleans them, along with the King's old clothes and shrinks them all.
Holly breaks her wand and must go to the Wand Factory, at the bottom of the Great Elf Tree, to get it fixed.

Peppa and family are on the search for a new home but after all the house viewings, nothing beats their home. Peppa then suggests they extend their house instead, so the family design a bigger house together.
The nurse visits and decides to focus on teaching proper baby-holding techniques. She demonstrates a safe method for a small person, like Peppa, to hold an infant correctly.

After Peppa and family visit a tourist spot with her new friend Birgit Bear, the caravan unhooks from the car. The bear family stops it just in time, and they finish the day jumping muddy puddles at the caravan park.

Mummy Pig and Peppa are at the zoo and meet Lorenzo Lion who lives there; he is helping his daddy, Mr. Lion the zookeeper, take care of the zoo; Lorenzo shows Peppa his toy zoo, but he keeps misplacing his wooden animals in his two bedrooms!
Peppa and her family go to the water park for an adventure, and Miss Rabbit is in charge. There are lots of fun things to do at the water park, but the first thing to do is to put on a swimsuit.
Peppa, George, Molly Mole and Freddy Fox play in the garden. Molly digs a tunnel and hits a box of pirate treasure.

Madame Gazelle takes the class through a simple tots workout at Peppa's playground that uses spinning hoops. Though they have fun playing with the hoops, they have a hard time spinning them around their waists as directed.
Peppa and her family have a day out at the seaside, and build a very large sandcastle with all their friends.
Farmer hires Willow's pet carnivorous plant to watch over his crops. Papa Smurf prepares a potion to boost his strength, but its effects are heavily altered due to a spider's intrusion.
Sid Swashbuckle pretends to be a legendary ghost so that he can take Danny's new skateboard; Ryder and the Pups race to save Mayor Goodway's Glow-in-the-Dark Party.
pr.sub: Pups vs. Ouchy Paws; Pups Save a Glow-in-the-Dark Party

pr.d: Rubble dreams that he's been taken aboard a spaceship and meets his alien double; the Pups must save Humdinger and his kittens when they mess around with Blinky the Clown's tiny clown car.
pr.sub: Pups Save a Rubble-Double; Pups Save a Clown

pr.d: Mica's Marsup journal ends up in Acu's bag, so he has to get it back before his friend finds it. Twister is fed up with Hope and Punch's pranks, so he builds his own cardboard house which Stan finds.
Out looking for Gaston, after banning him from the castle, the elves and fairies come across a speaking door which leads to the dwarf mine. Once in, they find they can't get out.
Using magic, Holly makes Lucy small enough to play in the Little Kingdom. Lucy has fun flying on Gaston the Ladybird and is invited to a sleepover at the Little Castle.
King Thistle wants bread for his royal breakfast, but there isn't any flour in the castle. Mr Elf takes everyone to the Elf Windmill to find out why it takes so long to make flour.
Queen Thistle has a beautiful new teapot that is so delicate that no one is allowed to touch it. Holly accidentally breaks the Queen Thistle's teapot and tries to fix it with Ben's help.
When Grandma gives Tim a hat she made herself, Tim is super excited, but unfortunately it keeps getting in the way.
Tim tests new rocket boots, which quickly spiral out of control.
Tim and Tia build a time machine to avoid confronting Dad and telling him the truth.
Stan is intrigued when he spots strange lights in the night sky. Grumblestunk thinks it's an alien invasion, but Stan and Gran are not so sure.
A fish has gone missing from Grandad's pond and his plastic 'scare' heron appears to have come to life! Stan and Gran suspect something fishy is going on!
An air collie makes an unlikely friend in 'When Pigs Fly', then in 'Familiar Territory', the Creature Catchers try a new ploy.
An air collie makes an unlikely friend. The Creature Catchers try a new ploy.

Peppa and George are watching a television show about Detective Potato and how he helps people find things. Daddy needs to buy some gravel so Peppa and George go with him. They park the car in a very large car park, but when they return, they can't remember where they parked it. Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel arrive to help Daddy Pig but have no luck. Suddenly, Detective Potato appears and saves the day.
Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival, a jigsaw festival. Peppa learns the secrets of puzzles from Grandma Donkey.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.

In this special episode, Speed Meister sabotages a speeding train, accidentally sending it towards a huge mountain! Rubble and Crew introduce their new demolition vehicles to smash through the mountain and build a tunnel to save the day!
pr.sub: The Crew Demolishes A Rock Mountain

pr.d: PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
pr.sub: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter

pr.d: When Maverick the daredevil Pterodactyl takes a tumble and hurts his wing, the pups are there for a sky-high Dino Rescue. A volcano is erupting, threatening the Dino Wilds! It's all paws on deck for a massive Dino Rescue.
pr.sub: Dino Rescue: Pups Save a Pterodactyl; Dino Rescue: Pups and the Big Rumble

pr.d: Gabby and Pandy share their new Meow Meow Mail with Cakey and work on a cure for a case of the hiccups.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Everybody is once again skiing on the mountains, but an unpredictable Mummy Pig showcases her skiing skills.
Madame Gazelle sets the children a creative task of making masks. There are carrot masks, robot masks, and even pretty butterfly masks. The only thing missing is lots and lots of glitter.

Daddy Pig receives a letter saying he must go away on business to test some very important concrete. Peppa, Mummy and George all decide to go with Daddy and enjoy a train journey, where they sing to pass the time.

Peppa and her friends head to the trampoline park where Miss Rabbit shows them how to bounce. As Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig and Mummy Sheep watch the children play, they decide they want to have a go at trampolining.
Peppa and her friends, accompanied by Mummy Sheep and Granny Sheep, take Vanessa to Grampy Rabbit's boatyard for inspiration. The children create various artworks using items found around the yard.
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy!
It's the day of the London Marathon! Peppa and family come to cheer Daddy on. Peppa and George see many runners dressed in funny costumes - and then they spot Daddy.

Peppa and her family are watching television when it suddenly stops working. While Grampy Rabbit attempts to repair it, the family acquires a new, multifunctional TV. However, they soon realise their old set was preferable.
The elf and fairy children learn all about how the rubbish from a picnic can be recycled into beautiful new toys.
Ben is in training for the elf games, and Holly wants to join in but the rules state there is absolutely no flying or magic allowed. Ben gives Holly a chance to join in without using magic.
When Thomas and Percy transport an unlucky boxcar of bananas, Thomas starts to have bad luck wherever he goes and must find a way to break the curse.
When Nia causes an accident that sends sand into Tess's gears during a big delivery, Nia tries Sandy's new super-grease as a solution.
Stan is intrigued when he spots strange lights in the night sky. Grumblestunk thinks it's an alien invasion, but Stan and Gran are not so sure.
A fish has gone missing from Grandad's pond and his plastic 'scare' heron appears to have come to life! Stan and Gran suspect something fishy is going on!
Join Tim Rex, brother Tommy, sister Tia, and Triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions! Tim, Tommy, Tia and Dad get stuck on a remote asteroid.
Tim has a clear out of all his old stuff but soon finds not all of it is destined for the rubbish tip.
Join Tim Rex as he tackles kid-shaped problems with dino-sized solutions in space! Tia's new balloon gets stuck in a tree, so Tim tries to get it down.
Paddington has to decide whether to support England or Peru before the football match, but he loves both countries. It's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still time for one last adventure.
pr.sub: Paddington's Football DIlemma; Paddington Has to Say Goodbye

pr.d: It's the day of Penny Polar Bear's party and the children find out they will be playing ice hockey! They are kitted out in safety gear at the ice rink and have great fun learning to play.
Mr Meerkat shows the children a huge wall that needs painting. They create a fantastic mural using lots of different techniques: brushes, sponges, buggy ropes and even a paint cannon!
It's the day of the duck race! When Miss Rabbit gives the sign, everyone drops their ducks in the river at the first bridge - whose will make it to the second bridge first?

At the gym, Madame Gazelle is teaching the children about martial arts. Along with Mr. Bull, the children learn how to fall safely, balance and even how to throw punches in the right stance. Mr. Bull gives them their white belts.

Dr Hamster has brought a giant ant farm and opens the ant farm's lid to show how they got in. Nobody noticed they escaped and starting moving things in the classroom! The children place food around to lead the ants safely back.
Grampy Rabbit gives Peppa and her friends a tour of an exercise park. Since the machines are only for grownups, the kids do funny exercises instead.
After seeing an advert for the London Marathon, Daddy Pig applies to take part to show the kids what grit and determination really looks like!
After finding out Daddy Pig has a place in the London Marathon, Peppa and George help Daddy Pig become stronger with lots of different, though not all typical, exercises.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel have come to teach Peppa and her friends all about bicycle safety.
Mummy Pig has finally finished writing her first book and decides to take it to playgroup to read to the children with unexpected results.
Madame Gazelle takes the children on a trip to the Zoo where they get a tour from the zookeepers; Mr Lion, Mrs Crocodile and Mr Giraffe.
The Pig family visit the Kangaroo family in Australia! On their first day they fly into the outback in Mr Kangaroo's aeroplane, have a barbeque and play some cricket with a Koala.
Peppa is playing at Suzy's house and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in! She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio.
Peppa is at Suzy's house and there is a pile of cardboard boxes so, they take them outside to play with. Peppa turns the boxes into a cardboard shop, a spaceship and even a hospital.
Suzy describes a takeaway and the children want to make their own. Together they 'cook' and deliver the pretend takeaways to the parents. They get great reviews too.
Grandpa Pig has created a watering system, but he does not remember which button is which so Peppa and George help using walkie talkies. The Police hear their signal and are surprised.
Mummy and Daddy Pig are working in their home office and Peppa wants to 'work' like them too. Peppa decides that she needs her own office, so she takes the cupboard under the stairs.
Peppa and her family take a poorly swift to the vet's. After a night of rest, the swift recovers and Doctor Hamster releases it so it can fly around the world again.
While repairing a sea wall, Sandy and Carly accidentally cut off a consortium of crabs from shore! When the crabs wreak havoc the duo must redirect them to the water.
Are the rats in the wetlands really rats? We find out in 'The Mysterious Swamp Rats', and then in 'The Vanishing Mr. Blue', a Pied Flycatcher goes missing.
Who is Paddington's Special visitor that Jonathan and Judy have helped come from afar? // It's the last night of Hanukkah and Mr Gruber's Hanukkiah breaks before he can light the final candle.
The Windsor Ruby is missing in 'Paddington's Adventure Club Cracks The Case!', then in 'Paddington And Aunt Lucy's Special Recipe', the Browns set up a takeaway, but it's hard work.
A game between England and Peru causes 'Paddington's Football Dilemma', then in 'Paddington Has To Say Goodbye', it's time for Aunt Lucy to go home, but there's still one more adventure.
Auntie, Uncle Pig and cousin Chloe are coming for dinner and Peppa is allowed to join too! Peppa is very proud of staying up late - she even stayed up later than the Daddies.
Peppa and family are watching TV... until it breaks! While Grampy Rabbit fixes it, the family get a new TV which can do everything... but it doesn't beat their old TV.
A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.
A storm cancels Peppa and her family's adventure plans so they decide to take it inside. Using their imagination, they go sledding, climb a mountain and have a campfire in the attic.
Peppa and George are in Granny and Grandpa Pig's Garden. Granny's friends are playing folk music! They play music for Grandpa Pig and then Grandpa Pig makes apple juice for everyone.
It is bedtime and Peppa calls Kylie Kangaroo and is surprised to learn it's not morning or winter where she is! Daddy Pig explains this using a big ball to represent the earth.
While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.
While visiting Suzy and Emily's house, Peppa is surprised there are extra rules she doesn't have in her own house like no shoes indoors and no eating peanuts.
Uncle Otis is hurling down Jake's Mountain in a runaway mine car! Ryder and the Pups need to rescue him before it crashes.
Daring Danny X is performing a new stunt. He is harnessed over a canyon eating an extreme lunch when the wind blows him upside down.
Some pufflings get lost in 'Paddington's Puffling Rescue', then in 'Paddington Goes Under The Sea', Paddington enjoys a diving adventure with Jonathan and Judy - but where is her necklace.
The beach is a mess until 'Paddington's Beach Clean Up', then in 'Paddington's Holiday Farewell', the summer holidays have come to an end, so it's time to say goodbye to their new friends.
Paddington wants to make a special cake. Paddington and Mateo form a table tennis team.
pr.sub: Paddington Celebrates Mrs. Bird's Day; Paddington the Table 🎾 [Tennis] Tennis Champ!

pr.d: The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time.
Mr Elf has built a new boat to replace the one Big Bad Barry ate. He is nervous when the king commands him to take them on a cruise to a tropical paradise.

There's a pirate-themed holiday in town, but Zuma isn't in a festive mood. His revamped persona gets tested when a real pirate arrives, bent on hidden treasure and ready to destroy the town to get it!
PAW Patrol is a CG action-adventure preschool series starring a pack of six heroic puppies led by a tech-savvy 10-year-old boy named Ryder.
pr.sub: Pups and the Ace of the Skies; Pups Save the Babysitter

Peppa and her friends learn how to animate their drawings at playgroup.
Mum, Dad, Peppa and George decide to go to the beach on a beautiful sunny day. Suddenly, a little cloud covers the sun for a minute, but then it passes and the sun reappears.

Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day. After a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds the perfect artwork.
Grandpa is building something in his shed. It is his latest pet project. It's a robot called Frank.
Miss Rabbit shows Peppa's family around the Botanical Gardens.
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden and together they learn to hop, skip and jump.
Madame Gazelle teaches the playgroup to play the recorder. After lots of practice at home, they put on a concert for their parents.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George decide to take all the things they don't use anymore to the charity shop, which raises money to help others.
Peppa and George are playing at their grandparent's garden on a very hot day but they don't have a paddling pool.
Mummy, Daddy, Peppa and George are going to the seaside. Mummy and Daddy explain clouds to Peppa and George who have a little sing and dance about clouds.
On a sleepover at the Sheep's house, Peppa and Suzy sit up in bed talking about what they will do when they are grown up.
The playgroup visits a nature reserve, specialising in tiny insects, bugs and butterflies. So Pedro brings along his pet stick insect.
Mandy Mouse joins Peppa's playgroup. She uses a wheelchair and is super sporty. The children have a lot of fun playing together.
Peppa and her family enjoy the apple tree at the top of the hill. It has a swing on it that they all like to swing on and Peppa has a special song for it.

Granny and Grandpa Pig are taking Peppa and George to a festival - a jigsaw festival! Peppa is amazed by all of the completed jigsaws around the festival.
When Daddy's car goes missing it's up to Detective Potato to find it.
Peppa and her friends learn about climbing from Grampy Rabbit at the climbing centre. Mummy Pig is worried about George when he gets scared of heights.
A new synthesiser arrives for Daddy Pig, and his family collect sounds for it from around the house while he is out at work.

Granny Sheep is driving Vanessa, the art van along the road with Peppa, Suzy, Pedro, Mandy, Molly and Danny. They are taking her to the boat yard, for her first-ever outing.
